# Prokolpo — Interior Design & Build Studio, Chattogram, Bangladesh

> Prokolpo (প্রকল্প, also "Prokolpo Designs") is an interior design and build studio in Chattogram, Bangladesh, working for 14 years with 200+ completed projects: apartments, duplexes, shops, offices and institutions. Every project is visualized in 3D before execution; the same team handles design, materials, carpentry, ceilings, lighting and site supervision until handover.

## Contact
- Studio: Azad Bhaban, 9th Floor, 79/A Jamal Khan Road, Chattogram 4000, Bangladesh
- Phone: +880 1738-125945
- WhatsApp: +880 1741-876037
- Email: prokolpo.designs@gmail.com
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Prokolpo.Designs
- First consultation is free.

## Services
- Residential interiors (flats, duplexes)
- Shop, showroom and office interiors
- Photoreal 3D interior visualization
- Custom furniture, carved prayer altars (Carve Studio)
- 3D wall murals, false ceilings and lighting
- Exterior design and turnkey execution
- Prokolpo Academy: 6-month offline interior design course in Chattogram (https://prokolpo-academy.vercel.app)
